title: Predict: Creating Empty Collections
hints: Each line creates an empty collection with a different spelling.
jsBridge: JS: `[]` and `{}` need no types. Swift: `[]` alone can't infer an element type, so you write `[Int]()`, `[String: Int]()` or annotate the variable. `Set` has no literal of its own; it borrows array literal syntax.

compass.q: Why can't Swift infer `let x = []`? What does TS infer for `const x = []` (`any[]` or `never[]`)?
`let s: Set = [1, 2]`: how does an array literal become a `Set`? (`ExpressibleByArrayLiteral`)
Should an empty array property be `var items: [Item] = []` or `[Item]? = nil`? What does each mean to the UI?
